article.headline: Old Dominion beats Norfolk State 71-60
article.description: — Zacch Wiggins scored 16 points as Old Dominion beat Norfolk State 71-60 on Wednesday.

categories.description: Old Dominion Monarchs @ Norfolk State Spartans

event.description: Old Dominion Monarchs @ Norfolk State Spartans

keywords: Old Dominion Monarchs @ Norfolk State Spartans
article.story: NORFOLK, Va. -- — Zacch Wiggins scored 16 points as Old Dominion beat Norfolk State 71-60 on Wednesday. Wiggins added six rebounds for the Monarchs (4-0). Jotham Nweke and Zamoku Weluche-Ume each added 10 points. Jordan Skyers finished with 19 points, six rebounds and six steals for the Spartans (2-2). Bahsil Laster added 17 points and two steals for Norfolk State. Up next Old Dominion takes on Longwood at home on Saturday, and Norfolk State visits Georgia State on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
